table.name: TLGNC_MAT_PLANT_TX
table.description: Language dependent data of a material plant entry. The majority of the data (quality assurance information etc) is either language indepdendent (and can therefore be stored on tlgnc_mat_plant), or is contained within the logos/images, where another method of language-dependen resolution exists (filename, filename_de, filename_en, ...). If, in the future, more of the text lines have to be made language dependent, move these attributes from tlgnc_mat_plant to tlgnc_mat_plant_tx (code change/release dependent).

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_lang_bs. For example de, en, ...

column.name: CHROMAT_REDUCTION_TXT
column.description: Text about 'chromat reduction' information shown on the delivery note if value tlgns_sap_bp.chromat_reduction_months of the ship-to is set. If this text is 'null', the LitDict value of key pdf.chromat.missing is used instead. One variable {0} can be specified. This variable is replaced by the value of tlgns_sap_bp.chromat_reduction_months of the shipto.
